forcedBody: This version is no longer supported. Please update to keep using Ritme.
installBody: Install Ritme on your home screen for quick access.
iosStep1: 1. Tap the Share button in Safari's bottom bar
iosSignInNote: The installed app asks you to sign in once; after that you stay signed in.
inAppBody: This page is open inside another app's browser. Use its ⋯ menu to open it in Safari or Chrome, so you can install Ritme and stay signed in.

sheet.title: Turn on notifications?
sheet.body: To remind you at dose time, Ritme needs to be able to send notifications to this device. You can turn them off whenever you like.

device.title: Notifications on this device
device.onHint: Your reminders and new notifications reach this device.
device.onHintShell: Medication and appointment reminders reach this device on time.
device.offHint: Turn it on so your reminders and new notifications reach this device.
device.offHintShell: Turn it on so medication and appointment reminders reach this device on time.
device.blockedHint: Notifications are blocked for Ritme. Allow them in your browser's site settings, then come back to this page.
device.blockedHintShell: Notifications are blocked for Ritme. Allow them in your phone's settings under Ritme's notifications, then come back here.
device.installHint: To get notifications, first add Ritme to your home screen, then turn them on from here.
device.failed: Couldn't turn them on. Try again in a moment.
